meta.project: National Unified Legal Metrology Digital Verification & Lifecycle Management Platform (e-Metrology)
authorities: The Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (Act No. 1 of 2010)

product_overview: A unified, multi-tenant national digital control plane for Legal Metrology instrument verification, physical lead-wire stamping reconciliation, PKCS#7 / Ed25519 digital certification, reference standard calibration hierarchy enforcement, and citizen-facing 256-bit QR authenticity verification in India.
core_goals: Digitize the end-to-end statutory verification lifecycle for 50M+ commercial weighing & measuring instruments
Enforce 28-digit exact rational decimal arithmetic and OIML R76 stepped Maximum Permissible Error (MPE) calculations with zero binary float drift
Ensure fail-closed safety by blocking verifications if working standards exceed their 24-month RRSL calibration validity or uncertainty limits
Preserve physical-to-digital parity linking physical lead-wire seal serials with immutable RFC 8785 JCS Ed25519 digitally signed certificates
Provide high-entropy 256-bit opaque QR tokens delivering zero-PII real-time authenticity projections with sub-50ms revocation propagation
Provide dedicated workspaces for Traders, Legal Metrology Officers (LMOs), Supervisors, National Administrators, and GATC Laboratories
Empower citizens and traders through a bilingual (English/Hindi) Ground-Truth AI assistant powered by Google Gemini 3.6 Flash / 3.5 Flash Lite with Web Speech STT/TTS
Support offline-first encrypted field verification with transactional outbox synchronization and deterministic server-side re-evaluation
Migrate and audit historical paper records via OCR parsing with a 4-tier provenance trust state machine
Reconcile government statutory fees via e-GRAS and BharatKosh double-entry ledgers with idempotent replay protection

backend.cryptography: Ed25519 DSC, RFC 8785 JCS, SHA-256 Digest
backend.ai_rag: Google Gemini 3.6 Flash / 3.5 Flash Lite + Local Statutory Rule Synthesizer

frontend.voice: Web Speech API (STT en-IN/hi-IN + TTS with onboundary word tracking)

features.name: Exact Metrology & Stepped MPE Engine
features.description: 28-digit rational decimal arithmetic evaluating turning point P, zero error E0, corrected error Ec, 5-position eccentricity, and 3-run repeatability spread for NAWI Class I, II, III, and IIII instruments.

features.name: Reference Standards & Traceability Validator
features.description: Hierarchy tracking (NPL -> RRSL -> State Secondary -> Working Standards), enforcing 24-month calibration limits and U <= (1/3)MPE uncertainty bounds with automated fail-closed blocking.

features.name: Cryptographic DSC & 256-Bit Opaque QR Verification
features.description: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization, SHA-256 digests, Ed25519 HSM digital signing, binary PDF/A rendering, and zero-PII 256-bit opaque QR tokens with sub-millisecond revocation.

features.name: Multi-Tenancy & Jurisdictional Access Control
features.description: Logical State/UT partitioning, composite ownership predicates, RBAC/ABAC guards for 8 roles, JWT auth with rotating refresh token families, and append-only audit ledgers.

features.name: Trader & Instrument Lifecycle Management
features.description: Instrument registration, 4-step statutory application wizard, Schedule XII automated fee calculation, e-GRAS/BharatKosh payments, appointment booking, and green Form 8 certificate vault.

features.name: Legal Metrology Officer (LMO) Workspace
features.description: Scrutiny queue, deficiency query management, guided 4-step NAWI tolerance calculator, physical lead seal recording, and DSC cryptographic certificate signing.

features.name: Supervisor & SLA Oversight Dashboard
features.description: State-wide pendency aging (<7d, 7-15d, 15-30d, >30d), officer turnaround metrics, workload rebalancing, and tamper-evident administrative audit logs.

features.name: National Administration & Master Data Portal
features.description: Dedicated governance app (apps/admin-portal), user provisioning, GATC laboratory accreditation, Central Model Approval registry, and 2-person approval workflows.

features.name: Bilingual Ground-Truth AI Assistant & Speech Engine
features.description: RAG over Legal Metrology Acts/Rules using Google Gemini 3.6 Flash / 3.5 Flash Lite, local deterministic rule fallback, portal deep-linking, and Hindi/English STT/TTS with word boundary speed control.

features.name: Offline Field Verification & Legacy Migration Pipeline
features.description: Encrypted local SQLite storage, assignment pre-caching, transactional outbox sync, client-side photo evidence SHA-256 hashing, and 4-tier legacy trust OCR migration.
